messages.author: 7a1a0c66d60b0f26
messages.subject: error on refineqtl command
parts:
I am modeling a binary trait and have been building MQM models using this function. The problem is that when I attempt refineqtl() this error message is reported:
Iteration 1 
Error in matrix.rank[i] <- attr(fit, "matrix.rank") : 
  replacement has length zero

Any thoughts on what the problem is? I am using the same sequence of verbatim inputs that I have used previously and that have worked perfectly for several other analyses over the past few years. This is a very new, and very strange result.

Thanks
